forest.name: Axel Vervoordt
forest.principle: 自然木、矿物墙与柔和日光保持平衡，重点家具的线条与材料比零散装饰更重要。
forest.palette: smoked natural oak, restrained dark cherry, warm-gray mineral plaster, muted moss/lichen linen, charcoal/aged bronze accents, neutral daylight
forest.changes: Keep the forest mood without all-over rustic orange timber or giant rope texture. Fine wool instead of chunky jute, tailored plain flax cushions instead of embossed floral fabric, slim downlight reading lamps instead of huge arch lamps, one small earth/ink abstract rather than generic botanical gallery. Straight-grain cherry/oak veneer, precise inset plinth and recessed pulls, thin eased timber edges, grouped window plants, subtle mineral variation.

japanese.name: Norm Architects × 芦泽启治
japanese.principle: 借鉴 Kinuta Terrace 对材料、光影与定制家具的整体处理，用细木构件和留白维持小空间的秩序。
japanese.palette: deep walnut and muted smoked oak, warm-gray white plaster, olive linen and small burnt-sienna accent, paper/opal light, dark bronze, balanced clean daylight
japanese.changes: Refine into a convincing Japanese mid-century home, not identical generic beige furniture. Walnut joinery with thin profiles and slim exposed timber rails, small recessed pulls, tactile wool rug with a subdued olive/rust geometric border rather than giant circles, simple hand-made ceramic, soft paper/opal lamps, low storage and generous empty working surfaces. Rectilinear aligned cabinet faces, thoughtful end grain and thin back panels, realistic small reveals. No RGB, no fake rice-paper entire walls or decorative beams.

french.name: Pierre Yovanovitch
french.project: Architecture d’intérieur et Mobilier / craftsmanship and proportions
french.principle: 借鉴其对比例、灯光与工艺的重视，控制墙线、家具弧度和织物的尺度，避免满屋重复的复古符号。
french.palette: muted honey oak, putty/ivory mineral wall, dusty blue and soft sage, tiny old-rose accent, aged brass, clean neutral daylight
french.changes: A restrained lived-in French vintage home: one thin correctly proportioned molding rhythm, simple flat cabinet panels with a subtle bead only where useful, slim aged-brass pulls, softly rounded timber edges, beautiful plain linen seating with precise piping, restrained low-contrast rug instead of loud flower carpets, small opaline or pleated lamps, one artwork per focal wall. Remove repeated botanical posters, giant bouquets, over-carved handles/legs and faux palatial detail. Do not add a fireplace, arches, giant marble island or chandeliers. Keep real small apartment scale.

sunlit.name: Heju Studio
sunlit.principle: 借鉴其自然色彩与有触感材料的衔接，以浅木、细条纹和小面积柔绿形成节奏，控制陈列数量。
sunlit.palette: pale natural honey oak edge with chalky white surfaces, sage and oatmeal fine ticking stripes, restrained blush/terracotta accent, pale mineral wall, fresh grouped foliage, bright neutral daylight
sunlit.changes: Keep the reference home's wood-edge WHITE coffee table, green/oatmeal TICKING STRIPE sofa/bedding and window plant grouping. Make built-ins precise with thin real wood edge-banding, quiet reveals, aligned shelf brackets, small rounded corners and a recessed timber toe kick. Restrained subtle sage niche or cabinet face, a small handmade ceramic backsplash detail, one paper/opal task lamp. Replace crowded generic plant/flower/poster arrangements with three intentional heights at existing window. White surface stays matte and clean, no fake yellow sunwash, thick jungle plants on every shelf or huge rope patterns.

core: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create ONE highly refined NORMAL RECTILINEAR architectural interior photo in landscape3:2, output2048x1360 or largest available. Input1: current apartment360 panorama is GEOMETRY/ADJACENCY evidence ONLY, NOT output projection. Keep the existing floor plan, original doors/windows and all previously approved functional layouts. DO NOT output360/equirectangular/fisheye, a collage, curved walls, a board of samples, an exterior or a close-up that loses the room. Correct straight verticals and a real28-32mm architectural lens, plausible small-apartment proportions. Every visible edge, reveal, textile seam and fixture must look built, not generic CGI: fine open wood grain at realistic scale, tiny eased edge, satin non-plastic metal, actual separate fabric weave, coherent tiled joints, properly supported shelves, meaningful surface contact shadows. Natural soft NEUTRAL daylight plus just a few local warm task pools; readable white balance, no overall yellow/orange haze, HDR halos or artificial blur. No people, text, visible brand logos, watermarks or cloned botanical art everywhere. This is an original home design informed by published general design principles, not a reproduction of a designer's named project.
